messages.content: Rewrite this one-day trip request the way a real traveller might type it: change the wording and the sentence order, informal is fine. Keep EVERY number, time (exactly as written, 24-hour HH:MM), money amount and place name exactly as written. Do not add, drop or change any requirement. Output only the rewritten request.

Starting at 09:00, I've got 14 hours and 55 minutes to spend. I'm starting from National Museum of Singapore. My budget is S$62. I want to visit Singapore Botanic Gardens. If there's time, I'd also like Merlion Park, Singapore Cable Car and Spectra Light and Water Show. I want to do Singapore Botanic Gardens before Singapore Cable Car. I'd like to spend 30 minutes at Singapore Cable Car. I want to be at Spectra Light and Water Show no earlier than 19:00 and done there by 20:15.

response: I'm starting at National Museum of Singapore at 09:00 with S$62 to spend and 14 hours and 55 minutes available. My main target is Singapore Botanic Gardens.
